acceptedAnswer.text: An IoT mold-risk prevention and detection system. A compact sensor pod watches a room, runs a Mold Risk Index over those readings, and closes the loop by switching a connected dehumidifier on and off. Live readings and history are in the app and web dashboard.

mainEntity.name: How does it detect mold risk?

acceptedAnswer.text: It does not look for mold directly. It scores the conditions mold needs: relative humidity, temperature, and how long those conditions persist, plus a virtual surface dew-point margin so condensation headroom is part of the score. VOC readings are supplementary context, never standalone proof.
Yes. When the index crosses the risk threshold the connected dehumidifier is switched on automatically, and switched off again once conditions return to a safe range.
Live room status, current environmental readings, the risk state, humidity / temperature / dew-point trends, the automation rule that is currently running, and alerts as risk rises.

mainEntity.name: Can I monitor more than one room?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Multi-room and multi-unit views are part of the design, aimed at larger households, dormitories, and property managers.

mainEntity.name: How do I set it up?

acceptedAnswer.text: Place the unit (tabletop or wall-mounted, near a humidity-prone area), connect it to WiFi, and let the loop run.
Emptying the removable 1 L water tank that collects the extracted moisture. The tank is monitored, so you are told before it is full.
MoldGuard is a fixed-cost build rather than a subscription: itemized hardware, one development fee, and full ownership with no recurring monitoring fee.
Homes, dormitories, and property managers who have humidity-prone rooms and want the risk handled rather than merely displayed.
